anya: Need final call on public comms for the API outage: short statuspage copy, RCA visibility (public vs on-request), and redaction rules. Goal: lock by EOD Thu.

olivia: paste current short blurb?

anya: draft:

```
Status: Resolved
Summary: Between 02:10 and 03:45 UTC on 2026-03-18, some API requests experienced elevated errors due to a capacity provisioning failure. We deployed a targeted configuration rollback and services have returned to normal. Affected customers may request a detailed incident summary from support.
```

mike: keep public wording high-level. avoid internal terms like "autoscaling path".

sam: legal prefers on-request for anything containing logs/traces.

nina: confirm: public high-level summary ok. full RCA only on request after redaction; if sensitive traces remain, require NDA. redaction checklist: remove customer IDs, IPs, raw spans, keys, internal hostnames; note sampling on any retained metrics.

mike: decision: publish high-level summary only. infra to produce redacted RCA for requests. owner: mike. timeline: draft redaction Fri EOD, legal sign-off Mon.

sam: CS flow: customer requests -> create infra-redaction ticket with incident id + customer id. i'll draft CS template by Thu.

anya: recurring issue note: third scaling-related incident in 9 months. add remediation epic (owner: mike, infra-runtime). proposals by 2026-04-08.

olivia: action list i'll own statuspage copy. 1) Finalize public blurb  owner: olivia  due Thu EOD; 2) CS template  owner: sam  due Thu EOD; 3) RCA redaction draft  owners: mike,nina  draft Fri EOD, sign-off Mon; 4) Open remediation epic  owner: mike  create by Mon.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-18-API-123 closed by anya. Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-18-API-123

anya: thanks. i'll publish the short status update after legal confirms redaction approach. closing thread.
